# PXI

> PXI is a privacy-first event platform built around the memory. Attendees discover events, buy tickets, shoot into one live shared camera roll, and wake up to a scrapbook that compiles itself the morning after — plus a digital passport of verified attendance stamps. Organizers get white-label ticketing (revenue paid straight to them via Stripe), live door scanning, real-time analytics, audience campaigns, and forgery-proof signed tickets. Pricing is simple: free to use, with a flat $0.99 platform fee on paid tickets. Free events cost nothing.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://pxispace.com/): What PXI is — tickets, the live shared camera roll, and the morning-after scrapbook, for attendees and organizers.
- [Platform](https://pxispace.com/platform): The organizer product — white-label ticketing, live door control, analytics, and audience tools.
- [Pricing](https://pxispace.com/pricing): Free tool; flat $0.99 per paid ticket; free events are free; early-access perks; contact and demo booking.
- [Events](https://pxispace.com/events): Discover public events and open the app; the product surface, separate from the marketing site.
- [About](https://pxispace.com/about): Why PXI exists — memory is the product; privacy-first, organizer-friendly.

## Features
- [Shared event photo gallery](https://pxispace.com/features/shared-event-photo-gallery): One live camera per event; everyone shoots into a single thread.
- [Digital event passport](https://pxispace.com/features/digital-event-passport): Verified attendance stamps and an Odyssey score, Bronze to Platinum.
- [White-label ticketing](https://pxispace.com/features/white-label-event-ticketing): Your brand, your revenue, paid directly via Stripe.
- [Event promoter analytics](https://pxispace.com/features/event-promoter-analytics): Hype, funnels, and heatmaps in real time.
- [Instagram event sharing](https://pxispace.com/features/instagram-event-sharing): One-tap framed post cards from your scrapbook, for trips and organizer promo.
